verdict.rationale: LM Studio's CLI docs explicitly show assigning a custom identifier when loading a model (`lms load openai/gpt-oss-20b --identifier="my-model-name"`), and the REST/OpenAI-like API server (docs-9, docs-5) lets that identifier be referenced consistently in subsequent API calls. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that the identifier persists reliably across API calls and no mention of editing/renaming identifiers post-load.
